# Steinberg ASIO SDK 2.3.4

This directory contains the minimum interface headers required to build the
System Audio Route driver. They were extracted without modification from the
official Steinberg archive:

- Source: `https://download.steinberg.net/sdk_downloads/ASIO-SDK_2.3.4_2025-10-15.zip`
- Archive SHA-256: `d5ebf0c20dd2c5f43771fd0c1418f4b361bf52434ee670097cfa6b3a335e2eca`
- Upstream release date: 2025-10-15
- Included files: `asio.h`, `asiosys.h`, `iasiodrv.h`, and upstream
  `LICENSE.txt`

System Audio Route uses these files under GNU GPL version 3. See the repository
`LICENSE` file. ASIO is a trademark and software of Steinberg Media
Technologies GmbH; no Steinberg logo artwork is redistributed here.
